limitations: Source inspection only; no lab or browser run. The walkthrough agent should confirm each new claim, in particular the sort orders, the Show-flag Match any behavior and the saved-search reopen flow.
Rapid-click issue #751 is tracked separately, as the registry says; not inspected here.
Failed reads can only be produced on a lab by blocking requests in the browser, as DOC-029 did.
DES-094 open points stand and the guide describes them as built: the saved-search selection ends when the dialog closes; the results page announces dropped Fields but not removed standard properties.

The header list and the results page parse the same words differently when they contain or or a leading - (see productBugs). The guide does not tell readers to use these as operators anywhere, so no step depends on it.

productBugs.file: apps/api/src/modules/search/service.ts (groupedSearch/flatSearch pass q to websearch_to_tsquery unquoted; querySearch quotes each word via terms())
productBugs.symptom: The header list treats `or` and a leading `-` as operators, but See all results turns the same text into words.all, where they are plain words. Typing `lease -draft` shows header rows without draft, then the results page requires draft.
productBugs.contradicts: DOC-009 M44 close addendum clause 5 (a simple q becomes words.all and should keep its meaning) and clause 2 (words compile through the English full-text parser including alternatives and exclusions), which 1e53979b changed for rows only.

sharedFileRequests.request: Line 21 says to use global search 'for words inside an earlier Version'. Search reads only each Document's latest Version (service.ts document_version_candidates uses max version_number). Change it to say search covers the latest Version's words, and earlier Versions are opened from the record's Documents tab.
